baslik: Real footage: 4 astronauts' trip around the Moon, start to splashdown 🚀🌕 #shorts
aciklama:
Artemis II: the 10-day journey from liftoff to Pacific splashdown, in NASA's own footage.

On April 1, 2026, the SLS rocket lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida and sent four astronauts aboard Orion around the Moon. The crew reached 252,756 miles from Earth, the farthest humans have ever traveled, breaking Apollo 13's record. Orion hit the atmosphere at roughly 25,000 mph and splashed down under three giant parachutes off San Diego on April 10.

Crew: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (NASA), Jeremy Hansen (CSA)
